reasons.free: Free events are free to run.
reasons.tickets: QR tickets, wallet passes and door check-in included.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: We sent a sign-in link. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
sent.bodyTo: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.

login.intro: No password. We'll email you a link that signs you in, and create your account the first time.

errors.Verification: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.AccessDenied: You can't sign in with that account.
errors.Configuration: Sign-in isn't configured on this instance yet. Check RESEND_API_KEY.
errors.RateLimited: Too many sign-in links requested. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.EmailSignin: We couldn't send the sign-in email. Try again in a minute.
errors.Default: Something went wrong signing you in. Try again.

onboarding.title: Name your organization
onboarding.description: Events are published under an organization: a company, a community, or just you. You can invite teammates later.

form.name: Organization name
form.slugHelp: Your public page will live at {preview}. Event pages will use /{slug}/event-slug. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
form.websiteHelp: You can enter adobe.com — we'll add https:// automatically.

notFound.title: Invite not found
notFound.description: This link isn't valid. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.

invite.title: Join {org}
invite.description: You've been invited to {org} as {role}. The invite was sent to {email}.

unsubscribe.title: Reminders for {event}
unsubscribe.stopped: Done. You won't get reminder messages for this event. Your ticket and any changes to the event still reach you.
unsubscribe.confirm: Stop reminder emails and texts for this event? Your ticket stays valid.
